approaches.title: Dynamic programming for Fibonacci recurrence
approaches.summary: Computes the number of ways to reach each stair using the recurrence ways(n) = ways(n-1) + ways(n-2). The second revision preserves this strategy while reducing storage to constant space.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Uses a vector to store dynamic-programming values for all stair counts and returns the value at n.
Replaces the DP vector with a two-value rolling state that accumulates the same recurrence in constant space.
